name: YNAB
tagline: Personal budgeting app built around zero-based budgeting and habit formation

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; monthly plan listed at $14.99/month and annual at $109/year.

verdictSummary: A zero-based budget app with accounts, categories, envelopes, and reports is very buildable; bank sync and habit coaching are the main paid value.
coreLoopDIY: Build account/category tables, assign dollars to categories, import transactions, reconcile balances, and show budget reports.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the method and mobile/bank-sync habit are easier to follow than a spreadsheet.

priorArt.name: Actual Budget
priorArt.desc: Open-source local-first budgeting app and one of the strongest YNAB alternatives.

notes: One of the best consumer-subscription yes pages due strong prior art.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for YNAB (Personal budgeting app built around zero-based budgeting and habit formation). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build account/category tables, assign dollars to categories, import transactions, reconcile balances, and show budget reports.
- Needs: local or hosted database.
- Needs: CSV import.
- Needs: optional bank aggregation API.
- Needs: reporting charts.
- Needs: backups.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: bank sync; mobile apps; educational method/content.
